# Copilot Instructions

Before any UI/UX or frontend work, read `AGENTS.md` (reading order and ECC
precedence), then follow `frontend-ui-ux-engineering-rules.md` (repo root) and
use `docs/ui/ui-registry.md` as the index of tokens, components, and screens
(keep it updated). Values come only from `src/styles/tokens.css` and
`src/styles/typography.css`; design intent, vocabulary, and product rules are
in `docs/ui/DESIGN.md`.
